jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Support software development for connected medical devices across a portfolio including feeding, RF ablation, and pain recovery systems.
• Review and interpret software deliverables from external development partners and CDMOs.
• Maintain internal software knowledge of products, including functionality, architecture, and dependencies.
• Develop and maintain system and software documentation, including requirements, architecture, traceability, and Design History File content.
• Support software-related risk management, investigations, and sustaining engineering activities for commercialized products.
• Read and interpret embedded software, firmware, and application-level code to support technical reviews and troubleshooting.

What You'll Need
• Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• 8-10 years of architecture, technical design, and software development experience.
• Ability to read and understand embedded code, firmware, application-level code, and related diagrams.
• Experience reviewing software requirements, design documentation, test documentation, and traceability records.
• Strong understanding of requirements management and traceability across the development lifecycle.
• Hands-on experience with secure boot implementation and firmware upgrade mechanisms.

What's On Offer
• Competitive salary
• Hybrid work schedule with required onsite presence Tuesday through Thursday.
• Comprehensive benefits package including health, retirement, and work/life benefits.
• Opportunities for professional development and to contribute to innovative healthcare solutions.

Apply via Haystack today!

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Support the development and integration of air traffic management systems for a federal aviation program.
• Focus on system management, ensuring seamless functionality and modernization of air traffic control operations.
• Utilize core technologies including Ansible, Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and Linux system administration.
• Work with container technologies like Podman/Docker and manage virtual machine lifecycles.
• Contribute to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines.

What You'll Need
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
• Less than 2 years of prior relevant experience.
• Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and Bash/Shell.
• Experience with Linux system administration, particularly Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
• Familiarity with containerization (Podman/Docker) and virtual machine management (VMware, KVM).
• Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

What's On Offer
• Competitive annual salary ($69,550 – $125,725) plus potential for bonuses.
• Opportunity to work on critical national airspace system modernization projects.
• Hybrid work environment with a mix of in-office and remote work.
• Exposure to enterprise infrastructure management and mission-critical system deployment.

Apply via Haystack today!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We're hiring on behalf of a Haystack partner!

The Role
• Design, develop, test, and maintain production software for a mission-critical, future-ready automation platform.
• Serve as Scrum Master for an Agile development team, facilitating ceremonies and removing impediments.
• Guide the team through SAFe cadence, including PI planning, iteration planning, and backlog refinement.
• Track and communicate team flow metrics, velocity, and PI objective progress to drive continuous improvement.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to communicate team status, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress.
• Leverage modern DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-assisted development tools.

What You'll Need
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience, or Master's with 6+ years.
• 5+ years of experience designing, developing, testing, and reviewing production Java applications.
• 2+ years of experience serving as a Scrum Master on a SAFe Agile team.
• Experience designing and implementing microservices and RESTful APIs.
• Significant experience with the Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and Spring Security.
• Experience with unit testing frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito.

What's On Offer
• Competitive annual salary ($107,900 - $195,050) plus potential for bonuses.
• Opportunity to work on systems where performance, precision, and reliability are paramount.
• Engage with disciplined, responsible AI applied to mission-critical software supporting national infrastructure.
• Comprehensive benefits package including health and wellness programs, income protection, paid leave, and retirement.

jobs.description:

The Role
• Serve as a technical leader and strategic architect for enterprise data solutions.
• Design, develop, and maintain microservices-based applications using modern software engineering best practices.
• Collaborate with product owners, architects, and engineers in an Agile/SAFe environment.
• Develop clean, maintainable, and testable code following CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
• Integrate services with databases, messaging systems, and external APIs.
• Utilize AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, refactoring, debugging, and test creation.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

• Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Java, Python, C++, or similar on a Linux-based system).
• Experience or exposure to AI/ML-enabled systems, automation, or intelligent platforms.
• Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust investigation.

• Competitive annual salary ($107,900 - $195,050) plus potential benefits.
• Opportunity to work on mission-critical software impacting national infrastructure.
